title: Kati backup payload
description: One data/<table>.json inside a .katibackup archive. See docs/backup-format.md.

resource.description: The Ash resource these rows came from. Informational; a reader keys on 'table'.

table.description: The table name. Must match the member's filename: data/<table>.json.

count.description: Number of rows in this file. Must equal both the length of 'rows' and the manifest's record count for this table.

columns.description: Every column of the table, sorted by name. Identical for every row in the file, including columns that are always null.

rows.description: The rows, sorted by primary key. Each object's keys are exactly the 'columns' set — no extra key, no missing key.

items.description: One row. Values are encoded by column type: uuid/string/atom as strings, integer/float as numbers, boolean as true/false, date as YYYY-MM-DD, time as HH:MM:SS.ffffff, instant as ISO-8601 with an offset, decimal as a STRING, and anything absent as null.
